t: What he corrected when the animal stumbled
a: لاَ تَقُلْ تَعِسَ الشَّيْطَانُ فَإِنَّكَ إِذَا قُلْتَ ذَلِكَ تَعَاظَمَ حَتَّى يَكُونَ مِثْلَ الْبَيْتِ وَيَقُولَ بِقُوَّتِي وَلَكِنْ قُلْ بِسْمِ اللَّهِ فَإِنَّكَ إِذَا قُلْتَ ذَلِكَ تَصَاغَرَ حَتَّى يَكُونَ مِثْلَ الذُّبَابِ
p: Lā taqul: taʿisa-sh-shayṭān. Fa-innaka idhā qulta dhālika taʿāẓama ḥattā yakūna mithla-l-bayti wa yaqūla bi-quwwatī. Wa lākin qul: bismi-Llāh. Fa-innaka idhā qulta dhālika taṣāghara ḥattā yakūna mithla-dh-dhubāb
m: Do not say: may Satan perish. If you say that he swells until he is the size of a house and says, by my power. But say: in the name of Allah. If you say that he shrinks until he is the size of a fly.
